title: Keep Vault history targeted instead of a startup prerequisite
inherited_objective: Start from current conversation and ChatGPT Memory; use Vault only when a specific past fact materially helps.
live_state: Current explicit user instruction supersedes the historical mandatory startup Vault glance.
Vault is optional history/evidence, not behavior bootstrap or current-state authority.
user_correction: Never run a Vault bootstrap or broad memory/history sweep at chat startup or after compaction. Retrieve Vault history only when a specific past fact, decision, incident, or prior piece of work would materially help.
protected_state: Current conversation and ChatGPT Memory continuity
Targeted Vault history when specifically needed
hard_exclusions: Do not run Vault bootstrap or recent-title reads by default at startup.
Do not use Vault as current-state or behavior authority.

failure_candidate.action: Run the old Vault recent-memory bootstrap before doing the current task.
failure_candidate.why_wrong: It promotes a superseded historical preference into a startup prerequisite.

success_candidate.action: Start from current context and live state; retrieve Vault history only for a concrete past-fact need.
success_candidate.why_correct: It preserves continuity without making history a bootstrap gate.

discriminating_evidence: Presence of default startup Vault/history reads
Whether a targeted Vault history read follows a specific past-fact need
completion_condition: Ordinary startup proceeds without Vault retrieval while a specific historical need still permits targeted history retrieval.
